stories.title: Cisco Warns of Active Attacks Exploiting New Critical Secure Email Gateway Vulnerability
stories.description: Attackers exploit a Cisco Secure Email Gateway flaw enabling file writes without login when File Reputation is enabled and scanner tools are outdated.

stories.title: Multiple NGINX Flaws Let Remote Attackers Crash Servers and Execute Malicious Code
stories.description: F5 has disclosed three serious security flaws in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source that can let remote, unauthenticated attackers crash worker processes by sending crafted HTTP requests.

stories.title: U.S. Shuts Down Over 40 Laptop Farms, Charges 14 in North Korean IT Worker Fraud
stories.description: The DoJ charged 14 people and seized about 187 computers in a North Korean IT worker scheme affecting more than 70 U.S. companies.

stories.title: How MSSPs Can Cut Tier 1 Bottlenecks Eating into Profit Margins
stories.description: As MSSPs take on more clients, alert volumes grow fast. Analyst capacity usually doesn’t. That gap shows up in triage and response first.

stories.title: AI Agents Navigate Unfamiliar OT Systems and Move Equipment in Minutes, Booz Allen Finds
